body.name: One-unseen-row compatible RSCM class
body.construction: \(Mone=\{M: M\text{ is a finite RSCM over }S\text{ and }G;\ M\text{ induces the source groundings }Rsrc\text{ and target grounding }\rho\text{ encoded by }Ictx,\text{ its distinct exogenous variables are mutually independent, no ground endogenous variable has an exogenous relational parent, no non-relational exogenous variable is shared as a parent by distinct ground endogenous variables, its finite mechanisms are type shared, it reproduces }Psrc,\text{ it uses the rows }K\text{ recovered from positive-probability source parent contexts, and it has exactly one unrestricted target-relevant binary row at }rstar\}\).
